sources: N. M. Bryce, L. Johns & M. Langer, 'Living with impunity versus living in fear: Universal jurisdiction defendants, due process, and the use of democracies by autocracies to prosecute their opponents', (2025) 38 Leiden Journal of International Law 322-342, doi:10.1017/S0922156524000244
M. Langer & M. Eason, 'The Quiet Expansion of Universal Jurisdiction', (2019) 30 European Journal of International Law 779-817, doi:10.1093/ejil/chz050
note: Cases referenced in these two articles and cross-checked against the 198-case corpus. The Langer UJ database (complaints 1961-2022, updated across Langer 2011/2015, Langer & Eason 2019, Johns/Langer/Peters 2022, Bryce/Johns/Langer 2025) is itself a cross-reference source the site could cite alongside TRIAL International, UJAR, the CFJ Tool and Amnesty.

new_case_candidates.case_name: John (Ivan) Demjanjuk (US extradition → Israel acquittal → Germany conviction)
